summary: This release uses stock OMP v18.8.9 as its engineering baseline. The 8 changelog entries below record the changes since v0.7.5. Historical receipts do not qualify these bytes.
highlights:
- This release uses stock OMP v18.8.9 as its engineering baseline. The 8 changelog entries below record the changes since v0.7.5. Historical receipts do not qualify these bytes.
- Request a gateway release weekly on Mondays at 15:17 UTC after the exact-version stock OMP canary. Scheduled requests skip when the lock already equals or exceeds npm `latest` or any trusted open tracking request exists, including a re-check before filing. Manual dispatch and fixes-only requests are unchanged.
- Move the OMP engineering baseline to published v18.8.9 (#390), with pins derived by `scripts/upstream-pins.ts`. Registry v1, discovery, the relay protocol, `collab.autoStart`, and the collaboration host and `collab-web` sources are unchanged from v18.8.3; the relevant-path changes add `/fork pane|window|tab` (can1357/oh-my-pi#13620) and `/dump anon` (can1357/oh-my-pi#15077), which the gateway does not use. The embedded client remains at v18.4.2. No qualification is claimed; published v0.7.5 stays bound to OMP v18.8.3.
- The release driver lands an order only from `carrythroughsystems[bot]` on a `carrythrough/*` head: the delivery App's new name and branch prefix.
- Verify only the exact digest-pinned v0.7.5 rollback predecessor using its retained original Cosign identity when historical build attestations are absent. Record that proof truthfully in qualification and approval; candidates and every other predecessor still require online GitHub attestations. Changed historical bytes or a failed signature refuse qualification.
- Run the release driver's detached jobs at interactive priority, as an operator's SSH session does. Its LaunchAgent ran as `Background`, then `Standard`, and every job it started inherited launchd's limits: on the Studio, `Standard` lowered their base priority from 31 to 20 and stretched a 10 ms sleep to 58–73 ms. v0.7.5's approve check failed three times on cross-process lease tests that pass over SSH, stopping the release after its campaign had passed.
- A busy release-host lease now refuses after one busy timeout instead of two. Bun's `Database.exec` ignores a failed statement unless it is the last one, so a contender went on past its busy `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and waited again on its next statement. The repository check now rejects multi-statement `exec` calls on `bun:sqlite`.
- Publication and revocation waits now fail with their deadline message when a session-list read is still pending at the deadline, instead of the read's own timeout.
- A retried published-byte smoke can now be recorded. The release driver ran the smoke without `--force-reinstall`, so a retry found v0.7.5 already active from the failed attempt, skipped the install and reported `gateway.installed: false`, which the record generator rejects. The driver now always reinstalls the published bytes.
